## Usage

Capture state before a diagnostic scan. Follow the returned snapshot token using the same filters; later writes do not change these saved revisions.

See the [durable state guide](../../guides/playbook-state.md) for authority, quotas, protected storage, migration review and failure semantics. The `state_v1` feature remains gated pending D2.

Example command arguments:

```json
{
  "prefix": "scan/",
  "record_space": "kv",
  "pagination": "snapshot",
  "page_size": 100
}
```
